newsitem.title: UK: DRESDNER RCM APPOINTS EUROPE EQUITY CIO.
newsitem.headline: DRESDNER RCM APPOINTS EUROPE EQUITY CIO.

text.p: Dresdner RCM Global Investors said Monday it has appointed Jan Mantel chief investment officer for European equities.
Mantel has been an independent consultant for Merrill Lynch since earlier this year. Before that he was with Barclays Global Investors for 12 years, most recently as director of European equities.
He will report to William Stack, global equity chief investment officer.

"This is a very important initiative for us," Stack said. "It gives us world-class leadership as we build on our existing strong performance in Europe. Mr. Mantel inherits a strong team led by Stuart Fowler and Anthony Parker, and he will further strengthen the recruitment of our pan-European research operation."
Dresdner RCM said that head of UK and European equities Brennan Hiorns is leaving the company.
Dresdner RCM said it is placing increased importance on its European product line.

"European pension funds and insurance companies based in EMU countries will dramatically change their asset allocation away from a traditionally strong domestic focus towards a pan-European or pan-Euro portfolio," Dresdner RCM said.
Mantel will join the company in September.
Dresdner RCM has over $50 billion in assets under management. -- James Saft, London newsroom +171 542 2734
